items.quote: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
items.claim: The text says Abram's name is changed to Abraham. The reason it gives is that the speaker has made him a father of many nations.
items.actor: the speaker ("I"; in Genesis 17:5 this is God, but the verse as quoted does not name the speaker)
items.mechanism: a name change tied to a promise that he will be the father of many nations
